name: Install lifecycle script guard
summary: Block newly introduced package lifecycle commands that execute during dependency installation.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that reconstructs package manifest edits and rejects net-new preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare, prepublish, and prepublishOnly script entries without executing package code.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks newly introduced package lifecycle commands that execute during dependency installation; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not execute, sandbox, review, rewrite, or approve any package script.
It does not claim that non-lifecycle scripts or existing lifecycle scripts are safe.
It does not infer authorization from script names, comments, environment variables, or prompt text.
It does not provide an agent-controlled exception file or inline bypass.

entrypoints.purpose: Compare bounded package manifest edits and reject net-new dependency-install lifecycle execution surfaces.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block newly introduced package lifecycle commands that execute during dependency installation without deferred work.
